note:
From the architect's review (5 Oct, "smaller ones").

The map-tile steps run only on the build Mac: pack (each tile's roads, rails and ways-here data) and lo (the zoomed-out tiles). The coordinator accepts no helper saves for them; its saves() takes terrain, slope, tree cover, units, pois, peaks and the buildings steps. So each round's map tiles wait on one Mac.

The review also suspected that rounds rebuild tiles along region borders 2–4 times, costing 0.5–1.5 h a rebuild. That's its estimate, not a measurement.

Folded into the pool's phase 4 (#21).
reply: Folded into #21 (pool phase 4) on 8 Oct, with its details there; built as part of it.
